Is pacifism still relevant as war rages in Ukraine? What is the point of peaceful demonstrations when the aggressor will stop at nothing? Tracks East gives a voice to the Ukrainian, Belarusian and Russian opposition and peace movements.
From 20.04.2023 17:01

item.title: Tracks East - Love in Wartime (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (21.03.2023)
item.description:
In Ukraine, long-distance love is the new normal. Indie pop icon Ingret Kostenko had a meteoric rise to fame until the Russian invasion forced her to flee to Germany. The man she loved was a soldier at the front and she went home regularly to see him. This separation is the inspiration for Ingret’s music.
From 21.03.2023 14:25

item.title: Tracks East - Daily life in Putin's Russia (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (26.09.2023)
item.description:
Eighteen months after Russia invaded Ukraine, how is Russian civil society coping with Putin’s dictatorial drift? Tracks East investigates with journalist and debunker of fake news, Masha Borzunova.
From 26.09.2023 16:33

item.title: Tracks East - Children of War (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (21.02.2023)
item.description:
In war it is often the children who suffer the most. Their stable home lives are destroyed and they have to flee. According to Ukrainian sources, 12,000 Ukrainian children have been taken to Russia, the Kremlin says they have been ‘brought home’.
From 21.02.2023 05:00

item.title: Tracks East - Dictators: Control over Mind and Body (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (07.12.2022)
item.description:
“The world has lost its love for democracy. The world has become disappointed with the power elite. The world has begun to turn to dictatorship” So said Dmitry Muratov, editor-in-chief of the Moscow opposition newspaper Novaya Gazeta, on receiving the Nobel Peace Prize in 2021. While Belarus and Russia are striking examples of dictatorships,  Tracks East also looks at the situation in Iran.
From 07.12.2022 14:41

item.title: Tracks East - Anti-war Folklore (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (14.09.2023)
item.description:
Since Russia invaded its neighbour, Ukrainian culture has been enjoying a revival. Folklore in particular is a means of resisting the invader by strengthening the country's cultural identity. Tracks East looks at the craze for traditional song and dance as well as the refusal of some artists to express their patriotism through music.
From 14.09.2023 14:12

item.title: Tracks East - This is my body! (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (13.06.2023)
item.description:
In many countries, the state wants to control your body: the clothes you wear, your facial hair and for women, even their pregnancies. Tracks East meets Polish journalist and mixed martial-arts fighter Maja Staśko to find out the situation in Poland and the world.
From 13.06.2023 13:20

item.title: Tracks East - Turkey: The New Generation (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (10.05.2023)
item.description:
A new generation has come of age in Turkey that doesn’t want to live like their parents. On social media, on comedy stages and in rap music a counterculture is flourishing. Filmmaker Ufuk Cam goes to Turkey to uncover the local scene.
From 10.05.2023 17:37

item.title: Tracks East - Putin's Russia: The Opposition (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (25.04.2023)
item.description:
Can Russia be transformed from within? Russian journalist Mascha Borzunova and Russian actor Jean-Michel Scherbak give voice to people Putin wants to silence: dissidents, opponents and artists in Russia and in exile.
From 25.04.2023 15:32

item.title: Tracks East - Underground (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (30.03.2023)
item.description:
With Russian missiles raining down over their cities, Ukrainians have no choice but to take refuge below ground. After more than a year of war, basements, bunkers and metro stations have become more than just temporary shelters. Tracks East looks at what life is like underground.
From 30.03.2023 18:02

item.title: Tracks East - The Polish Paradox (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (29.09.2023)
item.description:
Tracks East finds out how militarisation, migration, and an increasing polarisation within society are affecting the mood in Poland as elections approach.
From 29.09.2023 15:47

item.title: Tracks East - Hierarchies – Who’s in Charge? (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (24.01.2023)
item.description:
Addressing the issue of exploitation and power relations in Eastern Europe and Central Asia, Tracks East focuses on Armenia, Azerbaijan and Russia.
From 24.01.2023 17:22

item.title: Tracks East - Humour as a Weapon (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (13.12.2022)
item.description:
When bombs are raining down all around, when freedom of expression is removed, does this make you laugh? Tracks East looks at how humour is used as a weapon in testing times in Belarus, Ukraine and Bulgaria. (And how dictators don’t have a very developed sense of humour.)
From 13.12.2022 17:27

item.title: Tracks East - Mobilisation (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (16.11.2022)
item.description:
Tracks East interviews Ukrainians who refuse to take up arms and Russian men who have been living in fear of being called up since the call for partial mobilisation.
From 16.11.2022 17:25

item.title: Tracks East - Pop, Power and Propaganda (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (14.09.2023)
item.description:
In Russia, the regime has a musical army of pop artists who perform patriotic songs that glorify the Russian people. Some artists criticise the regime and are duly side-lined. What happens when pop music meets propaganda?
From 14.09.2023 16:45

item.title: Tracks East - When Politics Destroys Families (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (20.06.2023)
item.description:
The family should be a haven of peace, a model of cohesion. But what happens to this cocoon when it is shaken by political conflict and war? Some try to reinvent the bond while others cut ties.
From 20.06.2023 11:03

item.title: Tracks East - Anti-Putin Russians (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (17.05.2023)
item.description:
Increasing authoritarianism means that Russian citizens have to decide: Do they stay quiet and allow freedom to die? Or do they speak up and risk changing their lives for ever? Tracks East meets Russians that could not accept the Putin dictatorship and now live in exile.
From 17.05.2023 15:29

item.title: Harry vs William - A Royal Quarrel (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (10.08.2023)
item.description:
The Royal prince’s bond of brotherhood used to seem unbreakable but recently Princes William and Harry have not been getting on. But what are the reasons behind the breakdown of their relationship? Spotlight on a royal feud that is both a private tale of family woe and a sensational tabloid story.
From 10.08.2023 10:37

item.title: How Streaming Consumed Music (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (19.09.2023)
item.description:
Having every piece of music imaginable in your pocket is normal today, but it took several a lot of upheaval in the music industry to get us there. Music-lover and journalist Sophian Fanen tells us how we went from CDs to streaming, from scarcity to infinite access. He traces the history of our listening habits in the 21st century through the mp3, illegal downloads, the iPod, to streaming services.....
From 19.09.2023 19:30

item.title: The Blade Runner Phenomenon (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (07.10.2023)
item.description:
An exploration of the 1982 Ridley Scott film Blade Runner. Slated when first released, it has since built a cult following for its visionary urban setting as well its unique futuristic film noir atmosphere. 
From 07.10.2023 05:00

item.title: Dalida & Orlando - Brother and Sister Forever (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (28.07.2023)
item.description:
Dalida was an international star, selling over 140 million records in 10 languages. But behind her glittering career and dramatic and tragic personal life, was her ever supportive younger brother Orlando. The documentary sheds light on the professional and personal relationship between the music icon and her producer, between sister and brother.
From 28.07.2023 05:00

item.title: The Versace Saga (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (17.07.2023)
item.description:
The Versace story is a family story of glory and tragedy that reads like a glamorous soap opera.  In the late 1970s, Gianni Versace founded a small family business that would grow into a global fashion empire with his older brother in charge of the finances and his sister as artistic director. His audacious designs would revolutionise the fashion industry. 
From 17.07.2023 11:00

item.title: Jean-Claude van Damme - Karate King (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (06.10.2023)
item.description:
The muscles from Brussels has enjoyed a dizzying career as a high-octane action movie star. The highs and lows of his eventful life are told with archive footage and contributions from those close to the much-loved Belgian actor.
From 06.10.2023 18:04

item.title: Beyoncé and Solange - The Queen of Pop and her Soul Sister (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (24.07.2023)
item.description:
Whilst Beyoncé has reigned over the world of pop for fifteen years, Solange has struggled to make her mark as a musician and move out of her older sister’s shadow. This is the story of two siblings from their comfortable upbringing in Houston to the world stage.
From 24.07.2023 12:29

item.title: Azzedine Alaïa - The French Couturier (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (25.09.2023)
item.description:
From a Tunisian farmer's son to a fashion designer in demand in fashionable Paris: How Azzedine Alaïa (1935-2017) became France's last great couturier. He learned his profession as an assistant in the shadow of well-known names, made his breakthrough in the 1980s with his figure-hugging robes and finally achieved world fame himself. Portrait of a discreet and frugal man who proved that his craft i.....
From 25.09.2023 12:15

item.title: Amanda Lear: Call Me Mademoiselle (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (21.04.2023)
item.description:
In the 70s, Amanda Lear was a disco queen, pop icon, model and world star. She enchanted Paco Rabanne, Andy Warhol, Bryan Ferry and David Bowie. She lived with Salvador Dalí and went out with Brian Jones of the Rolling Stones.A born performer, with legendary mystique and charm, she kept her true self hidden behind numerous faces. From Bowie to Berlusconi, from London to Paris: the story of Amanda.....
From 21.04.2023 05:00

item.title: The Inca Grass Bridge of Q'eswachaka (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (24.01.2023)
item.description:
In Peru, every year, the people who live in remote mountain villages gather to build the Inca bridge of Q'eswachaka, a traditional structure of woven grass, and the last of its kind. This ancestral know-how inherited from the Incas, and the enduring spirit of community, enables the villagers to pull off a stunning feat of engineering, time and again.
From 24.01.2023 10:27

item.title: Georgia: Teachers Needed - 360° GEO (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (09.10.2023)
item.description:
Svaneti is one of the most fascinating and remote regions of Georgia. But many mountain residents leave in search of a better life in the cities. Kala, a small village at almost 2,000 meters above sea level, is no exception. The local principal has just 17 pupils enrolled at the school.
From 09.10.2023 11:44

item.title: 360° Reportage - Istanbul: Cat City (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (19.08.2023)
item.description:
Hundreds of thousands of cats roam the streets of Turkey’s largest city. If they seem well fed and healthy, it's thanks to the locals who take care of them, sometimes very generously. It's an old tradition dating back to Ottoman times.
From 19.08.2023 05:00

item.title: GEO Reportage - Canada: The Maple Syrup Country (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (25.09.2023)
item.description:
In Quebec, the return of spring marks the beginning of maple syrup season. For Canadians, this sweet nectar is more than a nutrient-rich sugar substitute, it is an essential part of their culture. A staple of many regional recipes, this amber syrup made from the sap of maple trees, is produced mainly in Quebec and It is now one of Canada's leading exports.
From 25.09.2023 05:00

item.title: 360° Reportage - Buffaloes in Laos (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (02.10.2023)
item.description:
In Laos, water buffaloes are regarded as a ‘savings accounts for a rainy day’". If someone has to go to hospital, if the rice runs out or if a wedding icoming up, a buffalo is sold. But most of them are weak and malnourished. But innovative feed blocks could improve their health.
From 02.10.2023 05:00

item.title: Sierre Leone's Fashion Moguls (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (02.09.2023)
item.description:
In the neighbourhoods around Freetown's landmark, the 300-year-old Cotton Tree, a vibrant fashion scene has been growing for some time, in which women develop new styles and trends from traditional Sierra Leonean fabrics.For the past two and a half years, Mary Ann Kaikai has been teaching women Gara tie dye, the process of making batik fabrics, as part of a training programme. For single mother Is.....
From 02.09.2023 05:00

item.title: 360° Reportage - Women Winemakers of Mendoza (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (05.10.2023)
item.description:
The Argentinian province of Mendoza, at the foot of the Andes, is the country’s largest wine-growing region and where the famous Malbec grape variety is grown. Wine production has always been a man's business in Argentina. However, some women have decided to get involved and join forces to create their own wine. Despite many obstacles, their dream has become a reality.
From 05.10.2023 16:58

item.title: Geo Reportage - Dolphin Therapy in Curaçao (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (11.09.2023)
item.description:
Since 2004, the Dutch Caribbean island of Curaçao has been home to a dolphin therapy centre. Five dolphins help patients, young and old, to regain a taste for life. However, the effectiveness and seriousness of this treatment is criticised by some in the scientific community.
From 11.09.2023 05:00

item.title: Geo Reportage - South Korea: Magic Temple Food (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (05.08.2023)
item.description:
Far away from the South Korean capital of Seoul is the Buddhist Gameunsa Temple. Three nuns live, pray and cook together here as they preserve the knowledge of centuries-old temple cuisine. The abbess of this small monastery is the charismatic Wookwan Sunim, revered in Asia as one of the best cooks in the world.
From 05.08.2023 05:00

item.title: Lowriders of Los Angeles - Geo Reportage (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (12.08.2023)
item.description:
Lowriding is a passion for cars where owners customise their vintage vehicles to look cool gliding along the Los Angeles boulevards. For long a male-only pursuit, more and more women are getting into it lowriding.
From 12.08.2023 05:00

item.title: Jute of Bangladesh (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (01.08.2023)
item.description:
A look at the daily lives of jute producersin Bangladesh, a remarkable natural fibre that could get a boost from a new invention: biodegradable plastic made from jute cellulose.
From 01.08.2023 18:19

item.title: Elephant Hospital in Thailand - 360° Geo (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (14.10.2023)
item.description:
Considered lucky in Thailand, elephants are an integral part of Thai culture. In the north of the country, the only elephant hospital in the world has existed for over twenty years.
From 14.10.2023 05:00

item.title: The Bernina Express - A Train through the Alps (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (06.08.2023)
item.description:
From Chur, Switzerland’s oldest city, to Tirano in Northern Italy, the Bernina Express winds its way through deep valleys and wild gorges, crossing some 196 bridges and going through 55 tunnels in its journey through the Graubünden Alps. A journey to discover one of the most spectacular railway lines in the world and an audacious feat of engineering.
From 06.08.2023 05:00

item.title: Cuckoo and Co. (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (22.08.2023)
item.description:
We all know their strategy: The female cuckoo, to save having to bring up her young, places her eggs in other bird species’ nests. Astonishing footage from Europe and Africa of the cuckoo’s ingenious behaviour in the wild.
From 22.08.2023 05:00

item.title: Ireland's East Coast by Train (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (18.09.2023)
item.description:
Long beaches, spectacular cliffs, lonely mountains: from Rosslare in the southeast via Dublin to Howth runs probably the most beautiful train route in the Republic of Ireland. The area was shaped by Normans, Vikings and the turbulent history with England.
From 18.09.2023 17:39

item.title: World's Most Dangerous Railways - The Rameswaram Express (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (08.08.2023)
item.description:
The Rameswaram Express takes twelve hours to link the coastal city of Chennai in eastern India with the pilgrimage town of Rameswaram in the far south. Passengers cross bird sanctuaries, rice paddies, the sacred Kaveri River and the spectacular Pamban Bridge.
From 08.08.2023 05:00

item.title: World's Most Dangerous Railways - Argentina's Train to the Clouds (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (06.08.2023)
item.description:
In northern Argentina, El Tren a las Nubes or the cloud train traverses the spectacular landscapes of the Andes on vertiginous viaducts at an altitude of some 4,000 metres. Completed in 1948, this feat of engineering was designed to transport the region's mineral wealth to neighbouring Chile.
From 06.08.2023 05:00

item.title: World's Most Dangerous Railways - Peru's Andean Explorer (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (07.08.2023)
item.description:
The Andean explorer is one of the highest train lines on earth, running right through the mountains of Peru. To this day, it is considered a marvel of engineering. Its rails not only lead to the famous ruined city of Machu Picchu, but also connect the ancient Inca capital of Cusco with Puno on the shores of Lake Titicaca and the gleaming white city of Arequipa.
From 07.08.2023 05:00

item.title: World's Most Dangerous Railways - The Tazara: From Tanzania to Zambia (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (07.08.2023)
item.description:
In 1970, the construction of one of Africa’s most impressive infrastructure projects began: The Tanzania-Zambia-Railway. This programme accompanies the "Tazara" on its fifty-two-hour journey through the two countries and shows both the architectural monuments along the route and the breathtaking landscapes it passes through
From 07.08.2023 05:00

item.title: National Parks of the Future - Laos (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (24.08.2023)
item.description:
Nam Et-Phou Louey National Park in Laos is a rich habitat with bears, monkeys, clouded leopards and rare birds living among its thick vegetation. As ecotourism begins to take off, the biggest threat for the park remains poaching which has decimated the local tiger population.
From 24.08.2023 05:00

item.title: Fragile and Beautiful Mediterranean - The Island of Port-Cros (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (08.09.2023)
item.description:
Just off the coast from the French Riviera, Port-Cros is the smallest of the Hyères islands. Since 1963, its 7 square kilometres have formed the heart of Europe's oldest national park on both land and sea. In this living laboratory, conservationists and researchers from all over the world come to study this spectacular untouched ecosystems.
From 08.09.2023 05:01

item.title: La Palma - After the Eruption (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (09.09.2023)
item.description:
On 19 September 2021, the Cumbre Vieja volcano on the Spanish island of La Palma in the Canary Islands erupted. This spectactular and unexpected eruption was the largest in the last 500 years and a unique opportunity for scientists to study volcanic activity.
From 09.09.2023 05:00

item.title: Fragile and Beautiful Mediterranean - Pelagos: Marine Mammal Sanctuary (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (08.09.2023)
item.description:

item.title: Fragile and Beautiful Mediterranean - The Strait of Messina (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (08.09.2023)
item.description:
The waters of the Strait of Messina, which separates the Italian peninsula from Sicily, are virtually unexplored due to the powerful currents generated by the meeting of the Ionian and Tyrrhenian Seas, currents which also supports an exceptional biodiversity.
From 08.09.2023 05:01

item.title: Hungary by Train (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (18.09.2023)
item.description:
A trip through Hungary from west to east by rail taking in the famous Lake Balaton, the country’s most important music festival and the largest herd of buffalo in Hungary.
From 18.09.2023 11:34

item.title: National Parks of the Future - Peru (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (23.08.2023)
item.description:
The Yaguas National Park covers a large area of untouched rainforest in north-eastern Peru. Preserving such a huge area is highly important for climate protection. The local indigenous communities depend on the rich resources of the park which is vital for their survival.
From 23.08.2023 05:00

item.title: National Parks of the Future - Angola and Namibia (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (19.09.2023)
item.description:
In the Iona-Skeleton Coast Transfrontier Park, which straddles the border between Angola and Namibia, a landscape of dunes and plains stretches as far as the eye can see. The Namib Desert is home to jackals and cheetahs, some of the rare species able to survive in such an arid environment, as well as sea lions on the coast.
From 19.09.2023 18:03

item.title: Vietnam by Train (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (18.09.2023)
item.description:
The "reunification train", which links Hanoi to Ho Chi Minh City, also known as Saigon, takes you on a journey through the history of Vietnam. This railway line was rebuilt in the late 1970s, just after the Vietnam war, to encourage reconciliation between North and South.
From 18.09.2023 11:34

item.title: ARTE 360° Reportage - Nopal: Mexico's Green Gold (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (30.09.2023)
item.description:
The nopal cactus or prickly pear is the emblem of Mexico and is omnipresent in the country's cuisine. It grows in tight rows on the slopes of Milpa Alta, on the outskirts of Mexico City. Its medicinal properties are well known, now it is ready to conquer the world as a superfood
From 30.09.2023 05:00

item.title: ARTE 360° Reportage - Kourou: Palm Trees, Prisons and Rockets (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (22.07.2023)
item.description:
For nearly one hundred years the Salvation Islands in French Guiana was the site of a dreaded prison known as Devil’s Island. Today only ruins remain as the area has become a holiday destination. It is also used as a launching pad for the European Space Agency’s rockets.
From 22.07.2023 05:00

item.title: When Volcanoes Awaken (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (10.07.2023)
item.description:
Volcanoes can cause catastrophic disasters, but they are also one of the key drivers of evolution on our planet. This documentary tells the story of one volcano over 60 million years, with spectacular footage.
From 10.07.2023 08:00

item.title: Jacques Mayol, Dolphin Man (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (11.10.2023)
item.description:

Narrated by Jean-Marc Barr, the film draws us into Mayol’s world, capturing his compelling journey from Japan to Europe, India and the Bahamas, while immersing viewers into the sensory and transformative experience of free-diving. 
From 11.10.2023 05:00

item.title: Hans Hass - Pioneer of the Deep (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (27.07.2023)
item.description:
Portrait of Hans Hass (1919-2013), the Austrian biologist and underwater explorer who pioneered our understanding of the flora and fauna of the oceans through ground-breaking films.
From 27.07.2023 05:00

item.title: Reinhold Messner - Man of the Peaks (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (01.09.2023)
item.description:
Reinhold Messner is a mountaineering legend. From an early age he climbed the breathtaking Dolomites in his native South-Tyrol before conquering the highest peaks in the world. He shares his passion for mountaineering and his life philosophy.
From 01.09.2023 05:00

item.title: Anas Modamani, and a Fateful Selfie - Domino Effect (1/4) (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (24.08.2021)
item.description:

item.title: The Power of the German Constitutional Court (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (04.12.2021)
item.description:
The Federal Constitutional Court was founded 70 years ago. It is one of the most powerful institutions in Germany, along with the federal government, parliament and the Federal President. Often hostile to politics and respected by Germans, it has shaped the Federal Republic. But do these judges have too much power given they don't have a democratic mandate?
From 04.12.2021 21:53

item.title: Marie Laguerre, Street Harassment Hero - Domino Effect (2/4) (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (24.08.2021)
item.description:
Maire Laguerre was walking home from work when she was sexually harassed by a man in the street. When she told her aggressor to get lost, he threw an ashtray at her and punched her in the face. She decided to post the video of her attack online and it went viral, eventually triggering a change in street harassment laws in France.
From 24.08.2021 20:19

item.title: Joachim Roncin, the Mind Behind "Je suis Charlie" - Domino Effect (3/4) (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (24.08.2021)
item.description:
Joachim Roncin is the artist behind the iconic black and white image ‘Je Suis Charlie’. He was in the middle of an editorial meeting at Stylist when alerts started to come through: a fellow magazine, Charlie Hebdo, had been wiped out in a bloody massacre. Joachim’s image captured the pain of a nation.
From 24.08.2021 20:20

item.title: Ahed Tamimi, the Kid Activist - Domino Effect (4/4) (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (24.08.2021)
item.description:
Ahed Tamimi grew up in a small village in occupied Palestine, and protest was in her blood. She had grown up yelling at Israeli soldiers and demonstrating for a free Palestine. So the day that soliders showed up on her family’s property, she didn’t hesitate : she marched up to them and slapped them. Her anger would land her in prison and make her an icon of the resistance.
From 24.08.2021 20:22

item.title: The Resistance (3/4) - Unification: November 1942 - June 1943 (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (24.06.2023)
item.description:
A history of the French Resistance. Part 3: When allied forces land in North Africa, Germany takes over unoccupied France. Various resistance factions unite.

item.description:

In this episode: On 10 May 1940, the German Wehrmacht begins its Western campaign and by the summer, the conquered French sign an armistice. Many are indignant at the German occupation and the first resistance networks are formed.
From 24.06.2023 05:01

item.description:

item.title: A History of Antisemitism (1/4) - In the Beginning: 38 - 1144 (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (11.10.2023)
item.description:
From antiquity to the present day, a dense account of two millennia of intolerance and persecution of the Jews, supported by the fascinating insights from a host of scholars.

item.description:

item.title: Crazy Borders - Llivia, Between France and Spain (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (13.07.2022)
item.description:
Did you know that the last war between France and Spain took place in the 1970s? It was the war of the stop signs in Llívia, a Spanish town - but in France, in the Pyrenees. This bizarre quirk is due to a treaty signed centuries ago. This really is a case for Crazy Borders!

item.title: The Workers' Movement - The Barricades (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (02.06.2023)
